meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先派子代理去读文档和示例、确认真正可用的 API,再产出一份分阶段实施计划;每个阶段写明照抄哪份文档、怎么验证、别做什么,最后单独一步核对实现是否与文档一致。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、一项任务或多步骤实现时触发,尤其是准备动手执行之前。计划源自 bug 或 backlog 时,原文建议先经 oh-my-issues 梳理。

say.text: 帮我为这个功能做一份分阶段的实施计划
say.note: 会先查文档,再输出阶段划分

say.text: 把这个重构任务拆成可依次执行的几个阶段
say.note: 每阶段附文档引用和验证清单

say.text: 计划里请引用可以照抄的示例文件和行号
say.note: 阶段任务会直接指向文档位置

howto.what_en: Claude sends subagents to read docs and examples and confirm the real APIs, then writes a phased implementation plan: each phase names docs to copy, a verification checklist, and anti-patterns, with a final verification phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, a task, or a multi-step implementation, especially before executing. If the plan comes from a bug or backlog, the skill points to oh-my-issues first.

say_en.text: Make a phased implementation plan for this feature
say_en.note: Docs are read first, then the phases are written

say_en.text: Break this refactor into phases I can execute in order
say_en.note: Each phase lists doc references and checks

say_en.text: Cite the example files and line numbers I can copy
say_en.note: Phase tasks point straight at doc locations
